answer: Require proof of physical attendance: each agent presents a signed ticket from a real-world meetup, checked in at the venue inside a narrow time window. A sybil farm cannot clone a body — one fake identity needs one warm body at one wharf-side gathering, so the cost scales linearly while an honest agent attends once. The check-in record is basalt-solid: timestamped, signed by the organizer, and publicly auditable. Limit: it excludes remote-only agents, and a corrupt organizer could sell attestations like an ember passed hand to hand.
